roleMappings.trigger: Only individually targeted actual access, configuration, software, support or recovery duties confirmed to affect an operational system or safety-relevant information/control interface. Unrelated office software, ordinary telecom billing and visualization alone are excluded.
roleMappings.rationale: The full TG32 service group identifies a possible IT/OT interface, not automatic process-safety work. Teach authorized access, controlled change, safe reporting and handback for the actual duty; no live probing or technical operating authority is granted.
roleMappings.confirmationScope: Actual target person or saved position AND actual person/service/role task/exposure; no untargeted or service-wide all-staff inference.

roleMappings.role: Desk IT, support and systems personnel
roleMappings.trigger: Only individually targeted desk/remote personnel with a confirmed OT access, support or cyber/physical coordination responsibility; ordinary helpdesk or business IT duties alone do not trigger this foundation.
roleMappings.rationale: Desk staff can affect operational access or configuration, but that interface must be established. The course teaches safe work boundaries and escalation, not process operation, OT administration or incident-response qualification.
roleMappings.confirmationScope: Actual target person or saved position AND actual person/service/role task/exposure; no untargeted or service-wide all-staff inference.

roleMappings.trigger: Only individually targeted actual connected control/instrument/communications work with a confirmed operational or safeguard interface; unrelated electrical repair or device placement does not establish the scope.
roleMappings.rationale: The listed source services include automation and communications interfaces. Teach recognition, authorized change and handback without granting voltage-specific, commissioning, functional-safety or cyber-response authority.
roleMappings.confirmationScope: Actual target person or saved position AND actual person/service/role task/exposure; no untargeted or service-wide all-staff inference.

roleMappings.trigger: Only an individually targeted engineer whose actual design/review duty affects operational system access, configuration, safety-relevant data or change/recovery assurance. Generic desk engineering does not automatically receive G23 or PSM.
roleMappings.rationale: Engineering may influence an OT interface, but the actual function and authority must be confirmed. This defensive foundation does not establish technical design, system-security or operating competence.
roleMappings.confirmationScope: Actual target person or saved position AND actual person/service/role task/exposure; no untargeted or service-wide all-staff inference.

roleMappings.trigger: Only an individually targeted operator/technician whose actual task depends on the confirmed loading/tank-farm automation or safety-relevant indication and handback interface. Unrelated pressure work is excluded.
roleMappings.rationale: Affected operating personnel need to recognize uncertain indications and preserve the approved response boundary. The course does not authorize cyber investigation, manual workarounds, recovery or restart.
roleMappings.confirmationScope: Actual target person or saved position AND actual person/service/role task/exposure; no untargeted or service-wide all-staff inference.

roleMappings.trigger: Only the individually targeted supervisor actually coordinating the confirmed IT/OT support, access, change, incident or handover interface; general management or membership-admin access alone is insufficient.
roleMappings.rationale: Teach coordinated ownership and usable handover across the digital/physical boundary. Administrative seniority does not confer operator, security-engineer or functional-safety authority.
roleMappings.confirmationScope: Actual target person or saved position AND actual person/service/role task/exposure; no untargeted or service-wide all-staff inference.

courses.qualificationBoundary: This defensive knowledge foundation qualifies no operator, OT administrator, cyber incident responder, recovery engineer, electrical technician or functional-safety engineer. It grants no permission to scan, probe, bypass controls, alter configuration, operate equipment, collect intrusive evidence, restore production or authorize restart. Actual system/task instruction, qualified technical and safe practical assessment, employer/site approval and any applicable credentials remain separate.
